name: sebastopol-events
description: Sebastopol Events: every public event in Sebastopol, California (ZIP 95472) and the towns within about 22 km, the groups behind them, and a map. Rebuilt every morning from public calendars; anyone can add theirs.

scripts.gate: node scripts/check-voice.mjs && node scripts/check-data.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/check-voice.mjs && node scripts/check-data.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.all: npm run geocode && npm run fetch && npm run tasks && npm run build
